transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess I’m here because I feel low most days. I wake up and it’s like there’s this gray weight already on me. Even when I’m at work with the crew, or around my kids, I can’t really shake it. I’m just kind of going through the motions.
How long have you been feeling this way most days?
It’s been a little over three years now… about three years and three months. It started around when the groundskeeping contract changed our schedule, and the longer days kind of took over my life.
Have there been any times during these three years when you felt significantly better or had a period where the low mood lifted for a while?

Not really, no. It’s been pretty steady for about three years and three months now, since that groundskeeping contract changed and the longer days kind of took over. I can’t think of a stretch where it really lifted.
